csKnowledge: event-driven architecture with typed event payloads (success/error/timing/collision)
CAD-COMPLETE-MS0::U-CADC-LP01.buildNote: Bus must fail-loud on dropped/un-consumed events — silent event loss breaks the closed-loop NN training signal downstream.

csKnowledge: per-key metric aggregation (group-by adapter, running counters)
CAD-COMPLETE-MS0::U-CADC-LP02.buildNote: Route metrics to the CORRECT per-CAD NN head — a mis-routed feedback signal trains the wrong policy; assert routing with real adapter ids in tests.

csKnowledge: prioritized experience replay (sum-tree / proportional sampling by TD-error priority)
ring buffer with bounded capacity and eviction

csKnowledge: gradient routing across a two-level policy hierarchy (master + per-CAD heads)
CAD-COMPLETE-MS0::U-CADC-LP04.buildNote: Propagate the SAME outcome gradient to both master policy and the per-CAD head — verify both receive updates; assert with real loss-delta values, divergence guard on NaN/Inf.

csKnowledge: capability set intersection (intent requirements vs adapter feature set)
policy-driven fallback decision tree (fallback vs fail-fast)
CAD-COMPLETE-MS0::U-CADC-AI03.buildNote: Fail-fast path must surface the exact unmet capability (R12) — never silently degrade an unsupported intent; test both fallback and fail-fast policies with real capability gaps.

csKnowledge: B-rep + sketch tokenization (geometry -> discrete token sequence)
shared embedding / foundation encoder (frozen backbone feeding multiple heads)
byte-pair / vocabulary construction for geometry primitives

CAD-COMPLETE-MS0::U-CADC-NN02.buildNote: Consume the U-CADC-NN01 foundation encoder output — do not re-tokenize; assert op-sequence predictions against real Mastercam program data.
